text: Agent Notes Toolkit（AN）是一套面向项目的 Agent Notes 工具包，并可通过 DSH bundle 接入会话。它提供项目笔记目录脚手架、规则验证、迁移和 CI 接入命令；DSH 注册层还提供 notes-verify 工具及随 AN preset 加载的技能。验证会检查目录树、分类、格式、归档、链接和段落换行，初始化可生成笔记骨架，CI 设置可写入 GitHub 或 GitLab 工作流。适合希望把结构化 agent 笔记规则应用到项目并在本地或 CI 中检查的开发者。使用 DSH 集成需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

Agent Notes Toolkit (AN) scaffolds and verifies project notes. Its CLI and DSH commands initialize notes, check structure, format, links and wrapping, and connect checks to CI. DSH adds a notes-verify tool and preset skills. It helps developers keep agent notes consistent.
想给项目生成一套 Agent Notes 笔记目录和初始规则。
怎么检查项目里的 agent 笔记结构、链接和格式是否符合约定？
I want to add automated checks for our agent notes to CI.
Agent Notes Toolkit 的功能「笔记规则验证」：检查项目中的笔记目录树、分类、文件格式、归档、交叉链接和段落换行。可通过 DSH 的 notes-verify 命令或工具触发，返回通过状态和逐行结果。

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Agent Notes Toolkit (AN)：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

The portable Agent Notes mechanism: a decision-record tree, verification gates, a scaffolding CLI, maintenance skills, and the AN preset for dsh.

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Install：One-off use needs no install — `npx` runs the current version directly:

```sh
npx --yes @liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit an verify   # run once, nothing installed
```

The `--yes` form skips the install prompt; the package downloads into the npx cache and is never added to your project. Install it as a devDependency only when a project pins the toolkit version (CI, `npm run` scripts, repeated local use):

```sh
npm install --save-dev @liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit
```

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Install：Both forms run the identical engine; CI should use the pinned devDependency form (`npm exec an verify`) so a version bump cannot change what the pipeline runs.

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Use：```sh
npx an init          # scaffold the .agents/notes skeleton + seed note + version pin
npx an verify        # run every gate; exit 1 with one violation per line on failure
npx an ci-setup      # detect the CI vendor and write a standalone workflow file (never overwrites)
npx an migrate       # re-scaffold skeleton files to match the toolkit version; note content untouched

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Use：`an verify` runs six gates: `tree` (closed lifecycle/class tree), `classification` (legacy paths), `format` (header block + skeleton + alternatives), `archive` (frozen archive seals), `links` (relative links and anchors), and `wrap` (one physical line per paragraph). GitHub gets `.github/workflows/agent-notes.yml`; GitLab gets a standalone `.gitlab/agent-notes.yml` include file with the include line printed.

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · dsh integration：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit   # bundle from GitHub, no npm publish
an preset-install                      # the AN mode appears in the preset picker
```

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · dsh integration：The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the publish guide's GitHub install form resolves the bundle from the repository root. AN mode is an isolated agent preset, separate from standard/ptc/cordis: only its sessions get the `notes-verify` model tool and the AN skills (skills arrive through the tool plugin's runtime registrations — one delivery channel, no second one). The model tool, the commands, and the CLI share one engine (`lib/engine.js`): in-session tool calls and CI execute the same gate code. The bundle is self-contained (vendor sync + drift guard) and does not depend on the toolkit being installed.

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Release status：npm publish passes dry-run and `publishConfig.access` is `public`. The real publish needs one 2FA code per package (registry policy): run `npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org` in the repository root, then again in `packages/dsh-an/`, entering the code each time. The GitHub repository itself (including the git-dependency install path) is usable today.

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Contract：See [SPEC.md](SPEC.md) and the [Agent Note rules](scaffold/.agents/notes/README.md) (scaffolded into your project by `an init`). Every gate and CLI shares one engine; exit code 0/1 is the CI enforcement language.

@liangminhua/agent-notes-toolkit README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test        # node:test full suite
npm run verify  # self-hosted: this repository runs its own gates
```
